items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: Then we had to get Gormand [?] , we had to get the other piano player... we did this tour

ctx.x: Then we had to get Gormand [?] , we had to get the other piano player, we had another one, a guy that he didn't want to go on the tour yet. So we had Guy, Guy didn't go either because - so we had to take a trombone player and play some gigs, you know, like that. But we did this tour and went all the way to Casablanca and down there, in the Canaries [?] , you know. Everybody came back and we - I still stay with Bill, see, I'm still with Bill, see, because we wrestled with that tour together - long tour, see,…
And this would be what, '56 or so?
